title: Deduplicate tool/device_e2e/run{2,3,4,5,6,7}_full_suite.mjs into one parameterized orchestration module
rule: AG-1 (route through committed scripts, no ad-hoc variants) + Fowler duplication

evidence.quote: `## Judgment calibration (avoid the false positives from run 1)`,
excluded: ['#16 RTL segmented stranded — re-rejected (deferred workflow + run-2 confirmed SegmentedButton mirrors correctly...)'],

why: diff run2_full_suite.mjs against run3/4/5/6/7 shows each 256-line file differs from run2 by EXACTLY 3 lines (name, output dir, one description string) — 1536 lines of near-total copy-paste across 6 files. The concrete cost is visible: the calibration text 'avoid the false positives from run 1' (line 43) is frozen verbatim since run2, yet the SAME false positive (RTL segmented controls auto-mirroring) had to be independently rediscovered and excluded in run3 (run3_fix.mjs:104, '#10... contradicted between runs') and AGAIN in run5 (run5_fix.mjs:97, '#16... re-rejected'). Because the shared logic isn't factored into one module, a lesson learned in one run never propagates to the others — the next run(run8+) will hit the same wall.
recommendation: Extract the shared constants/builders (DEV map, driveGuide/seedPrompt/auditPrompt/verifyPrompt, the phase pipeline) into one importable module parameterized by {runId, priorFixSummary, areaPartitions}; each runN_full_suite.mjs shrinks to its run-specific area/seed data plus a call into the shared runner. Fold the RTL-segmented-controls lesson (and similar recurring false-positives) into the shared calibration text once, permanently.
acceptance_criteria: A shared tool/device_e2e/_full_suite_lib.mjs (or similar) exports the orchestration/prompt-builder logic; runN_full_suite.mjs files import it instead of redefining it.
Each new runN_full_suite.mjs is materially smaller than 256 lines (only run-specific data), checkable by a simple line-count grep in CI/Makefile.
The RTL-segmented-controls calibration note is asserted exactly once in the shared module (grep -c across tool/device_e2e/*.mjs returns 1, not 6).
